competency_statement_fil: TESDA BHS NC II — Develop Life and Career Decisions: naiuugnay ng BHW ang kanyang tungkulin at benepisyo sa legal na batayan nito, nasusuri niya ang sariling kwalipikasyon, at nagpapakita siya ng kalmado at matiyagang pag-uugali kapag humaharap sa mabagal na proseso.
competency_statement_en: TESDA BHS NC II — Develop Life and Career Decisions: the BHW connects their duty and benefits to their legal basis, assesses their own qualifications, and shows calm, patient behavior when facing a slow process.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Naipapaliwanag ng BHW, gamit ang sariling salita, na ang kanilang tungkulin ay may legal na batayan (RA 7883) at sila ay akreditado ng local health board.
observation_indicators.observable_en: The BHW explains, in their own words, that their duty has a legal basis (RA 7883) and that they are accredited by the local health board.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Naiiba ang paliwanag sa 'boluntir lang kasi gusto kong tumulong' nang walang binanggit na legal na batayan o proseso ng akreditasyon.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: The explanation stays at 'I just volunteer because I want to help,' with no mention of a legal basis or accreditation process.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naipapaliwanag nang tama at may kumpiyansa, kahit hindi tinatanong.
levels.kaya_na_en: Explains it correctly and confidently, even unprompted.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Naaalala lang kapag may untag na tanong ('saan ba galing ang tungkulin mo?').
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Only recalls it when prompted ('where does your duty come from?').
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Hindi maiugnay ang tungkulin sa anumang legal na batayan.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Cannot connect the duty to any legal basis at all.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Nailalarawan ng BHW ang mga benepisyong nakasaad sa RA 7883 at kung ano ang kailangan bago maging eligible dito, nang hindi tumitingin sa materyal.
observation_indicators.observable_en: The BHW describes the benefits named in RA 7883 and what is required to become eligible for them, without looking at the material.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Naaalala lamang na 'may benepisyo raw' nang hindi matukoy ang mga partikular na ito o ang rehistrasyong kailangan.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Only recalls 'there are supposedly benefits' without naming the specific ones or the registration required.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Nailalarawan ang hindi bababa sa apat na benepisyo at ang rehistrasyong kailangan, walang untag.
levels.kaya_na_en: Describes at least four benefits and the registration required, unprompted.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: May maalala pero dalawa o tatlo lamang, at hindi nauugnay sa rehistrasyon.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Recalls only two or three, and doesn't connect them to registration.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Isa o wala ang matukoy na benepisyo.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Identifies one or none of the benefits.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Naipapaliwanag ng BHW ang apat na kondisyon ng BHWE, at wastong nasusuri niya ang sariling katayuan laban sa bawat isa.
observation_indicators.observable_en: The BHW explains BHWE's four conditions, and correctly assesses their own standing against each one.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Naiiba ang BHWE sa pangkalahatang akreditasyon, o hindi maisa-isa ang apat na kondisyon.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Confuses BHWE with general accreditation, or cannot list the four conditions.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Tama ang apat na kondisyon at may tapat na sariling pagsusuri sa bawat isa.
levels.kaya_na_en: States all four conditions correctly, with an honest self-assessment against each.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tama ang dalawa o tatlo sa apat, kailangan pa ng untag para sa natitira.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Correct on two or three of the four, needs prompting for the rest.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Isa o wala ang tamang natutukoy na kondisyon.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Correctly identifies one condition or none.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Sa isang role-play o aktwal na sitwasyon, nakapagtatanong ang BHW nang kalmado at may tiyak na tanong sa halip na reklamo, kapag humaharap sa pagkaantala.
observation_indicators.observable_en: In a role-play or an actual situation, the BHW asks a calm, specific question rather than complaining, when facing a delay.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Nananahimik hanggang sa maantala nang malaki, o direktang nagrereklamo nang walang tiyak na hinihingi.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Stays silent until badly delayed, or complains outright with no specific ask.

levels.kaya_na_fil: May tiyak na tanong na nagpapakita ng kalmado at propesyonal na pag-follow-up, kahit sa mahabang paghihintay.
levels.kaya_na_en: Asks a specific question that shows calm, professional follow-up, even after a long wait.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nag-fo-follow-up pero minsan nagiging emosyonal o hindi tiyak ang tanong.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Follows up, but sometimes becomes emotional or the question isn't specific.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Nananahimik nang walang follow-up, o direktang nagagalit.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Stays silent with no follow-up, or becomes visibly upset.
